profile.headline: Senior Software/Firmware Engineer with deep collaborative experience in embedded software and firmware architecture, design, build, trouble shooting, debugging and testing
profile.summary:
Architect, Design, Build and Test embedded firmware systems for future AR, VR, and new platforms. Support all phases of hardware development including early architecture requirements definition for custom silicon, firmware architecture, implementation, simulation, FPGA debug, chip bring up and support systems and software teams on algorithm development on validated systems. Excellent communication with cross functional management and project management experience.

EXPERIENCE LEVELS
13 years of experience doing Bluetooth and BT smart chip firmware of Bluetooth 2.0, 2.1, 3.0, 4.0, 4.1, and 4.2.
10 years of experience doing embedded systems of Ethernet Switch, Home Gateway/Router.
3 years of experience doing SSD firmware of NVM Expression 1.3.
3 years of experience doing NFC (Near Field Communication) chips firmware.

ACCOMPLISHMENTS IN DEVELOPMENT
★ Bluetooth LE, BR/EDR applications, instrumental in winning large design contract
★ NVM Expression 1.3 specification in SSD firmware.
★ Bluetooth chips used in Apple iPhone series, Samsung mobile phones, LG mobiles phones, and HTC mobiles; used in automotive customers, Mercedes Benz, BMW, Audi, VW
★ NFC chips which are used in Black Barry Mobile phones, and Dell laptop systems.
★ D-Link Ethernet Switches for enterprise, Home Gateway/Routers for consumers.

TECHNOLOGY
★ Computer Languages: C/C++, C#, Assembly, HTML, Dynamic HTML, Java Script, Java, Perl, Python
★ Network Layer: TCP, UDP, IPv4, RIP v1/v2, SNTP, NAPT, IGMP, IPoA, IPoE, ARP, L2TP, PPTP. • Physical Layer: Ethernet Switch Driver, USB Driver, SPI Driver, UART Driver, I2C Driver, CAN Bus. • Embedded System Firmware ROM code and Run time code
★ Bluetooth Specification 3.0, 4.0, 4.1, and 4.2, Link Management Protocol, Host Controller Interface, Bluetooth Low Energy, Transport Protocol (USB, UART, SPI, SDIO), Sleep Mode, PCM interface, Boot Start Up
★ NFC (Near Field Communication), NFC-A, NFC-B, NFC-F Technology; Type 1, 2, 3, 4 Tags, Reader/Writer, LLCP, Security Element
★ Familiar with Microchip controllers, ARM, Motorola PowerPC, Intel x86 and FPGA
★ Operating Systems: UNIX, DOS, WINDOWS 3.xx/95/98/2000/XP/NT/Vista/7, LINUX
★ Real Time Operating System (RTOS): Nucleus, MT, Embedded Linux, uC/OS II, ThreadX
★ Debugger Software: RealView Debugger, MICE, PROM ICE, ICE, USBee, Logical Analyzer

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and implement Bluetooth LE, BR/EDR applications. 
• Debug Bluetooth Firmware for 20706, 20736, 20819, 20835, 20721, 20719, 43012, 43022 Bluetooth chips. 
• Reproduce, debug, and troubleshoot bug reports from customers. 
• Maintain BTSDK, watch, headset, low power, mesh, hello sensor, hello client, RFCOMM applications. 
• Design and maintain HAL driver, I2C, SPI, UART, power management.

positions.title: Senior Staff Firmware Engineer at Marvell Semiconductor
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented NVM Express 1.3 specification in firmware of Zao 3.0/3.2 SSD chip. 
• Designed and implemented Power Management in firmware of Zao 3.0/3.2 SSD chip. 
• Designed and implemented System Service in firmware of Zao 3.0/3.2 SSD chip. 
• Designed and implemented Admin command and I/O command in firmware of Zao 3.0/3.2 chip. 
• Designed and implemented Firmware Download/Firmware Commit in firmware of Zao 3.0/3.2 chip.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · 4 Years SSD Firmware

positions.title: Principal Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Gathered and Analyzed customers’ features requirement and bug reports.
• Planned, directed, and coordinated manpower to efficiently meet customer production deadlines.
• Reproduced, debugged, and troubleshooting bug reports from customers.
• Full development cycle of new NFC, Bluetooth chips product line.
• Organized product delivery schedules; ensured progress proceeding on schedule in development cycle.
• Worked with the hardware team to ensure correct exercising of hardware.
• Attended Weekly meetings with FAEs and customers to coordinate the problems and find solutions to meet the production time for customers’ requirements.
